reviews.text: Spring went off like a gunshot at 6 a.m. The tech showed me the snapped coil, explained why both get replaced, and had the door balanced by eight. He lifted it halfway and let go to prove it stayed put.
reviews.name: Renee K.

reviews.text: Our 2009 chain opener sounded like a lawnmower. The new belt drive is so quiet my teenager can sneak in now, which is a mixed blessing.
reviews.name: Tom A.

reviews.text: April hail left eleven dents across two panels. They replaced just those two sections and the color is close enough that the HOA never said a word.
reviews.name: Priya S.

reviews.text: Door kept reversing every afternoon when the sun hit the sensor. Forty minutes, a shade on the eye and a rewire. He showed me how to read the little lights myself.
reviews.name: Darnell W.

reviews.text: Got a written list after the tune-up: two rollers worn, one cable starting to fray, everything else fine. Nobody tried to sell me a new door.
reviews.name: Hannah B.

reviews.text: Off track with my car inside on a Sunday. They called back fast, told me not to pull the red cord, and were in the driveway before lunch.
reviews.name: Luis M.

proof.guarantee: Springs we install are covered for 5 years. If one breaks, we come back and replace it at no charge.
